data.one_liner: Monitors internet connectivity status, connection modes, and measures latency in real-time.
data.what_it_does: Combines OS-level hardware detection with active DNS reachability probes to detect exact connection modes like Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, or VPN. It provides built-in offline UI overlays, network-aware widgets, request retry logic, and an in-app network inspector.
use_when: You need detailed connection mode detection beyond basic on/off states.
Your app requires a customizable offline UI wrapper or banner.
You want to inspect HTTP network traffic or measure live connection latency.
avoid_when: You only need basic platform connectivity status without active reachability checks.
strengths: Detects connection modes like Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Ethernet, and VPN.
Includes prebuilt offline UI styles (Snackbar, Alert Dialog, Custom).
Provides a built-in in-app network logs inspector and ping latency tracker.
weaknesses: Depends on specific external packages like dio and connectivity_plus.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the watcher in main.dart using WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() and setup the wrapper at the root of the app.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic OS-level connectivity state changes without active reachability probes, offline UI overlays, or network inspection tools.
